chunks: And will return to his people full of joy.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says the believers will return to their people full of joy?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the concept of *al-Farh al-Azali* (eternal joy), where the believer's return to their *ahl* signifies not just physical reunion but the restoration of spiritual purity and familial bonds purified from worldly afflictions. Scholars emphasize that this joy is a direct reward for steadfastness (*sabr*) during the trials of the world, transforming the temporary separation of death into an eternal, blissful continuity.
